ctx.x: Bassist Jimmy Lewis was born in Nashville in 1918. He first played ukulele in bands, later picking up the bass to anchor some inspired jazz rhythm sections, including the Count Basie small group in the early 1950s. Jimmy has worked with Billie Holiday, Horace Silver and the Modern Jazz Quartet. His experience includes work in rhythm & blues as well, and he can be heard on albums with King Curtis, Ivory Joe Hunter and numerous soul organists.
